cache_diagnostic: Four arms use per-group observer. Their times are diagnostic. Fixed1024-output trace-off131K/250K sequences and natural-EOS pressure/revisit run on the final selected kernel image.
mechanism: Reuse existing inherited async-capable affine mixed-prefill feedback, first validate actual feedback/age with an opt-in scheduler observer, then run formal trace-off configuration ablations. No upstream sync-only scheduler port.
selection_before_results: At least5% lower empirical short-request p95 and at most5% observed regression in resident max chunk gap, inserted32K TTFT and whole-workload output throughput. Confirm a promising profile in a second independent process paired with a second baseline.
main_contract: Default8192 main kernel qualification is independent of optional efficiency presets.
sampling_limits: 36 short requests per formal process, three mixed trials. Counts are empirical, with fresh service process as independent unit. No stable p99 claim.
resources: Serial TP4 on6-9 after full kernel quality runs. Existing MinerU and ComfyUI remain running.
